brief: A wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins, hung from keyhole hangers.

requirements.evidence: Three full-depth bins: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, in a row of three hex cells.
Two hex-acc-keyhole accessories (accessory:0#-1,0#1 and accessory:0#1,0#1) fitted at the end cells; the cells are bolted into one body so both hangers carry the rack.

requirements.requirement: Reads as a spice rack (shows its purpose)
requirements.evidence: No spice-jar prop exists in the catalog; each bin is dressed with an upright kitchen vessel (glass/cup tumblers, prop:1-3, all visible from above) to indicate jar storage. Food/spice suitability depends on the user's chosen print material, which the configurator cannot verify.

finish.summary: A wall-hung spice rack: three hex cells in a row, each with a full-depth bin, bolted together into one body with solid end caps, and two hex-acc-keyhole hangers on the end cells so the whole rack lifts onto wall screws. Dressed with an upright kitchen vessel in each bin (no spice-jar prop exists) to show jar storage. check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
